        "contents": "/**\n * POST /api/reservations\n * Create a new reservation\n */\nexport async function POST(request: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n    const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n    if (!user) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: \"Neautorizováno\" }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const body: CreateReservationInput = await request.json();\n    const { room_id, title, person_count, start_time, end_time, is_cowork_open } = body;\n\n    // Validation - title is the reason (simplified)\n    if (!room_id || !title || !person_count || !start_time || !end_time) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Chybí povinné údaje\" },\n        { status: 400 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    const startDate = new Date(start_time);\n    const endDate = new Date(end_time);\n    const now = new Date();\n\n    // Check: end time is after start time\n    if (endDate &lt;= startDate) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Čas konce musí být po čase začátku\" },\n        { status: 400 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Check: not in the past\n    if (startDate &lt; now) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Nelze rezervovat v minulosti\" },\n        { status: 400 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Check: within booking window (2 weeks)\n    const maxDate = new Date();\n    maxDate.setDate(maxDate.getDate() + MAX_ADVANCE_BOOKING_DAYS);\n    if (startDate &gt; maxDate) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: &#96;Lze rezervovat maximálně ${MAX_ADVANCE_BOOKING_DAYS} dní dopředu&#96; },\n        { status: 400 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Check: within operating hours\n    const startHour = startDate.getHours();\n    const endHour = endDate.getHours();\n    const endMinutes = endDate.getMinutes();\n\n    if (startHour &lt; OPERATING_HOURS.start || startHour &gt;= OPERATING_HOURS.end) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: &#96;Provozní hodiny jsou ${OPERATING_HOURS.start}:00 - ${OPERATING_HOURS.end}:00&#96; function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n    const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n    if (!user) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: \"Neautorizováno\" }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n    const roomId = searchParams.get(\"room_id\");\n    const startDate      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name),\n        user:profiles(id, full_name),\n        team:teams(id, name)\n      &#96;)\n      .eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n      .order(\"start_time\");\n\n    if (roomId) {\n      query = query.eq(\"room_id\", roomId);\n    }\n\n    if (startDate) {\n      query = query.gte(\"end_time\", startDate);\n    }\n\n    if (endDate) {\n      query = query.lte(\"start_time\", endDate);\n    }\n\n    if (userId) {\n      query = query.eq(\"user_id\", userId);\n    }\n\n    const { data, error } = await query;\n\n    if (error) {\n      console.error(\"Error fetching reservations:\", error);\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Nepodařilo se načíst rezervace\" },\n        { status: 500 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    return NextResponse.json({ data });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(\"GET /api/reservations error:\", error);\n    return NextResponse.json(\n      { error: \"Interní chyba serveru\" },\n      { status: 500 }\n    );\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * POST /api/reservations\n * Create a new reservation\n */\nexport async function POST(request: NextRequest) {\n  try\n}",

        "contents": "# Zadání - Rezervační systém\n\n**Datum vytvoření:** 2026-01-29  \n**Status:** Kompletní zadání\n\n---\n\n## Místnosti\n\n| Kód | Název | Pravidla |\n|-----|-------|----------|\n| D126 | D126 | Běžná místnost, může mít TS |\n| D132 | D132 | Běžná místnost, může mít TS |\n| D226 | D226 | Běžná místnost, může mít TS |\n| D127 | Tichá místnost | Vždy dostupná, bez TS |\n| D129 | Reprezentační místnost | Vždy dostupná, bez TS |\n| D107 | D107 | Pouze středa, 1. středa = HC 9-12 |\n\n---\n\n## Training Sessions (TS)\n\n- Trvání: 4 hodiny\n- Frekvence: Týdně, stejný čas, stejný tým, stejná místnost\n- Nastavuje: Coach (jednou za půlrok)\n- Místnosti s TS: D126, D132, D226\n- Když probíhá TS, místnost není dostupná pro běžné rezervace\n\n---\n\n## Houston Calling (HC)\n\n- Kdy: První středa v měsíci\n- Čas: 9:00 - 12:00\n- Kde: D107\n- Kdo: Celá Tiimiakatemia (povinné)\n- Vytváření: Automaticky systémem\n\n---\n\n## Obecná pravidla\n\n1. Provozní hodiny: **7:00 - 22:00**\n2. Rezervace dopředu: **max 2 týdny**\n3. Max délka rezervace: **bez omezení**\n4. Časové sloty: **po 15 minutách**\n5. Jeden uživatel = jedna rezervace v daný čas\n6. Jedna místnost = jedna rezervace v daný čas\n7. Povinné údaje: důvod rezervace, počet osob\n8. Rezervace lze upravit a zrušit\n\n---\n\n## Funkce systému\n\n### Základní\n- Vytvoření, editace, zrušení rezervace\n- Kalendářový pohled (denní/týdenní)\n- Responzivní design (mobil/PC)\n- Filtrování podle času a místnosti\n\n### Speciální\n- **Coworking \"Join\"**: Toggle pro otevřenou rezervaci, ostatní se mohou připojit\n- **Hlášení závad**: Report nepořádku, technických problémů\n- **Zamčená místnost**: Hlášení + zobrazení všem uživatelům\n- **Alternativní místnosti**: Nabídka volných místností v požadovaný čas\n- **Analytika**: Statistiky vytíženosti, počet rezervací na uživatele\n\n### Coach dashboard\n- Nastavení rozvrhu TS pro místnosti\n- Výběr: místnost, tým, den, čas\n- Platnost: semestr",

        "contents": "/**\n * Main reservations page showing all rooms and user's reservations\n */\nexport default async function ReservationsPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  \n  // Get current user\n  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n  if (!user) {\n    redirect(\"/\");\n  }\n\n  // Check if verified\n  const { data: profile } = await supabase\n    .from(\"profiles\")\n    .select(\"is_verified\")\n    .eq(\"id\", user.id)\n    .single();\n\n  if (!profile?.is_verified) {\n    redirect(\"/verify\");\n  }\n\n  // Fetch rooms with current reservations and issues\n  const now = new Date().toISOString();\n  \n  const [roomsResult, reservationsResult, issuesResult, myReservationsResult, joinedIdsResult, coworksResult] = await Promise.all([\n    // All rooms\n    supabase\n      .from(\"rooms\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .order(\"code\"),\n    \n    // Current and upcoming reservations for today\n    supabase\n      .from(\"reservations\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n      .gte(\"end_time\", now)\n      .lte(\"start_time\", new Date(Date.now() + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString())\n      .order(\"start_time\"),\n    \n    // Open issues\n    supabase\n      .from(\"room_issues\")\n      .select(\"room_id, issue_type\")\n      .eq(\"status\", \"open\"),\n    \n    // User's own reservations\n    supabase\n      .from(\"reservations\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name)\n      &#96;)\n      .eq(\"user_id\", user.id)\n      .eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n      .gte(\"end_time\", now)\n      .order(\"start_time\")\n      .limit(10),\n    \n    // Get reservation IDs user has joined\n    supabase\n      .from(\"cowork_participants\")\n      .select(\"reservation_id\")\n      .eq(\"user_id\", user.id),\n    \n    // Available coworks (open for cowork, active, upcoming - include all, we'll filter later)\n;\n}",

        "contents": "# Fáze 6: Analytika rezervačního systému - Praktický rozbor\n\n## Úvod: Přístup orientovaný na výkon a jednoduchost\n\nTento rozbor se zaměřuje na **pragmatický přístup** k analytice - vyvážení mezi bohatostí dat a jednoduchostí implementace, s důrazem na minimalizaci zátěže databáze při zachování užitečných insights.\n\n---\n\n## 1. Analýza problému z pohledu výkonu\n\n### 1.1 Současný stav\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nreservations table\n├── ~100-500 rezervací/měsíc (odhad pro 50 aktivních uživatelů)\n├── 6 místností\n├── každá rezervace: 15min - 4h\n└── peak load: pondělí-pátek 9-17h\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 1.2 Výkonnostní rizika\n- **N+1 queries** při agregacích přes relations\n- **Scanning celé tabulky** bez správných indexů\n- **Concurrent access** během peak hours\n- **Complex JOINs** při multi-dimensional analytics\n\n### 1.3 Výkonnostní cíle\n- Dashboard load: &lt; 500ms\n- API response: &lt; 200ms\n- Nulový impact na rezervační flow\n- Škálovatelnost do 10k+ rezervací\n\n---\n\n## 2. Třívrstvý analytický model (doporučený)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│         VRSTVA 1: HOT DATA (Real-time)              │\n│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐  │\n│  │  PostgreSQL Counters (trigger-based)         │  │\n│  │  - Simple aggregates                         │  │\n│  │  - Updated on every reservation change       │  │\n│  │  - Used for: Today's stats, current week     │  │\n│  └──────────────────────────────────────────────┘  │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n                         ↓\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐",

        "contents": "/**\n * Helper function to create HC reservation if it doesn't exist\n * Uses admin client to bypass RLS for system operations\n */\nasync function createHCForMonth(\n  adminClient: SupabaseClient,\n  roomId: string,\n  targetDate: Date,\n  scheduleBreaks: Array&lt;{ start_date: string; end_date: string }&gt;\n): Promise&lt;{ created: boolean; date: Date; reason?: string }&gt; {\n  const firstWednesday = getFirstWednesday(targetDate);\n  const dateStr = firstWednesday.toISOString().split(\"T\")[0];\n\n  // Check if this date falls within a schedule break\n  const isBreak = scheduleBreaks.some(\n    (b) =&gt; dateStr &gt;= b.start_date &amp;&amp; dateStr &lt;= b.end_date\n  );\n\n  if (isBreak) {\n    return { created: false, date: firstWednesday, reason: \"schedule_break\" };\n  }\n\n  // Check if HC already exists for this date\n  const startOfDay = setMinutes(setHours(firstWednesday, 0), 0);\n  const endOfDay = setMinutes(setHours(firstWednesday, 23), 59);\n\n  const { data: existingHC } = await adminClient\n    .from(\"reservations\")\n    .select(\"id\")\n    .eq(\"room_id\", roomId)\n    .eq(\"reservation_type\", \"houston_calling\")\n    .gte(\"start_time\", startOfDay.toISOString())\n    .lte(\"start_time\", endOfDay.toISOString())\n    .eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n    .single();\n\n  if (existingHC) {\n    return { created: false, date: firstWednesday, reason: \"already_exists\" };\n  }\n\n  // Set time to 9:00 - 12:00\n  const startTime = setMinutes(setHours(firstWednesday, 9), 0);\n  const endTime = setMinutes(setHours(firstWednesday, 12), 0);\n\n  // Create HC reservation using admin client (bypasses RLS)\n  const { error } = await adminClient.from(\"reservations\").insert({\n    room_id: roomId,\n    user_id: null, // System reservation\n    reservation_type: \"houston_calling\",\n    title: \"Houston Calling\",\n    reason: \"Pravidelná měsíční schůzka první středu v měsíci\",\n    start_time: startTime.toISOString(),\n    end_time: endTime.toISOString(),\n  });\n\n  if (error) {\n    console.error(\"Error creating Houston Calling:\", error);\n    return { created: false, date: firstWednesday, reason: \"error\" };\n  }\n\n  return { created: true, date: firstWednesday };\n}\n\n/**\n * POST /api/houston-calling/generate\n * Generate Houston Calling reservations for current and next 2 months\n * This can be called by any authenticated user (system operation)\n * Uses admin client to bypass RLS for creating system reservations\n */",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

        "contents": "/**\n * GET /api/reservations/[id]\n * Get a single reservation\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest, { params }: RouteParams) {\n  try {\n    const { id } = await params;\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n    const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n    if (!user) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: \"Neautorizováno\" }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const { data: reservation, error } = await supabase\n      .from(\"reservations\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name),\n        user:profiles(id, full_name),\n        team:teams(id, name),\n        cowork_participants(\n          id,\n          user_id,\n          joined_at,\n          user:profiles(id, full_name)\n        )\n      &#96;)\n      .eq(\"id\", id)\n      .single();\n\n    if (error || !reservation) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Rezervace nenalezena\" },\n        { status: 404 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    return NextResponse.json({ data: reservation });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(\"GET /api/reservations/[id] error:\", error);\n    return NextResponse.json(\n      { error: \"Interní chyba serveru\" },\n      { status: 500 }\n    );\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * PATCH /api/reservations/[id]\n * Update a reservation\n */\nexport async function PATCH(request: NextRequest, { params }: RouteParams) {\n  try\n}",

        "contents": "import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from \"next/server\";\nimport { OPERATING_HOURS, TIME_SLOT_MINUTES } from \"@/lib/reservations/types\";\n\n/**\n * GET /api/reservations/availability\n * Check available time slots for a room on a specific date\n * \n * Query params:\n * - room_id: UUID of the room\n * - date: ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD)\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n    const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n    if (!user) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: \"Neautorizováno\" }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n    const roomId = searchParams.get(\"room_id\");\n    const dateStr = searchParams.get(\"date\");\n\n    if (!roomId) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: \"Chybí room_id\" }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    if (!dateStr) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: \"Chybí date\" }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Parse date\n    const date = new Date(dateStr);\n    if (isNaN(date.getTime())) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: \"Neplatné datum\" }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check room exists and get availability rules\n    const { data: room, error: roomError } = await supabase\n      .from(\"rooms\")\n      .select(\"id, code, name, available_days\")\n      .eq(\"id\", roomId)\n      .single();\n\n    if (roomError || !room) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: \"Místnost nenalezena\" }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    // Check if room is available on this day\n    const dayOfWeek = date.getDay();\n    if (room.available_days &amp;&amp; room.available_days.length &gt; 0) {\n      if (!room.available_days.includes(dayOfWeek)) {\n        return NextResponse.json({\n          data: {\n            room,\n            date: dateStr,\n            available: false,\n            reason: \"Místnost není dostupná v tento den\",\n            slots: [],\n          },\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Build date range for the day\n    const startOfDay = new Date(date);\n}",

        "contents": "export default async function ReservationsPage() {\nconst [roomsResult, reservationsResult, issuesResult, myReservationsResult, joinedIdsResult, coworksResult] = await \n\n\n      .eq(\"user_id\", user.id),\n    \n    // Available coworks (open for cowork, active, upcoming - include all, we'll filter later)\n    supabase\n      .from(\"reservations\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name),\n        user:profiles!reservations_user_id_fkey(id, full_name),\n        team:teams(id, name),\n        cowork_participants(\n          id,\n          user_id,\n          joined_at,\n          user:profiles(id, full_name)\n        )\n      &#96;)\n      .eq(\"is_cowork_open\", true)\n      .eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n      .gte(\"end_time\", now)\n      .order(\"start_time\")\n      .limit(50), // Increased limit to catch both joined and available\n  ]);\n\n  // Process rooms with status\n  const rooms = roomsResult.data || [];\n  const reservations = reservationsResult.data || [];\n  const issues = issuesResult.data || [];\n  const myReservations = (myReservationsResult.data || []) as ReservationWithDetails[];\n  \n  // Get IDs of reservations user has joined\n  const joinedReservationIds = new Set(\n    (joinedIdsResult.data || []).map((jp: any) =&gt; jp.reservation_id)\n  );\n  \n  // Split all coworks into joined and available\n  const allCoworks = (coworksResult.data || []) as ReservationWithDetails[];\n  const joinedCoworks = allCoworks.filter(c =&gt; joinedReservationIds.has(c.id));\n  const availableCoworks = allCoworks.filter(c =&gt; \n    !joinedReservationIds.has(c.id) &amp;&amp; c.user_id !== user.id // Exclude joined and own reservations\n  );\n  \n  console.log(\"User ID:\", user.id);\n  console.log(\"Joined reservation IDs:\", Array.from(joinedReservationIds));\n  console.log(\"All coworks count:\", allCoworks.length);\n  console.log(\"Joined coworks:\", joinedCoworks.map(c =&gt; ({ id: c.id, title: c.title })));\n  console.log(\"Available coworks:\", availableCoworks.map(c =&gt; ({ id: c.id, title: c.title })));\n\n  const roomsWithStatus: RoomWithStatus[] = rooms.map\n;\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * POST /api/reservations/join\n * Join an open cowork reservation\n */\nexport async function POST(request: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n    const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n    if (!user) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: \"Neautorizováno\" }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const body: JoinRequest = await request.json();\n    const { reservation_id } = body;\n\n    if (!reservation_id) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Chybí ID rezervace\" },\n        { status: 400 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Check reservation exists and is open for cowork\n    const { data: reservation } = await supabase\n      .from(\"reservations\")\n      .select(\"id, user_id, is_cowork_open, status, start_time, end_time\")\n      .eq(\"id\", reservation_id)\n      .single();\n\n    if (!reservation) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Rezervace nenalezena\" },\n        { status: 404 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    if (reservation.status !== \"active\") {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Rezervace není aktivní\" },\n        { status: 400 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    if (!reservation.is_cowork_open) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Tato rezervace není otevřená pro cowork\" },\n        { status: 400 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Can't join your own reservation\n    if (reservation.user_id === user.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Nemůžeš se připojit k vlastní rezervaci\" },\n        { status: 400 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Check if reservation is in the future or happening now\n    const now = new Date();\n    const endTime = new Date(reservation.end_time);\n    if (endTime &lt; now) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Rezervace již skončila\" },\n        { status: 400 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Check if user has conflicting reservation\n    const { data: conflicts } = await supabase\n      .from(\"reservations\")\n      .select(\"id\")\n      .eq\n\n\n;\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Coach dashboard for managing Training Sessions and schedule breaks\n * Only accessible by coaches and admins\n */\nexport default async function ReservationSettingsPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  // Get current user\n  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n  if (!user) {\n    redirect(\"/\");\n  }\n\n  // Check if user is coach or admin\n  const { data: profile } = await supabase\n    .from(\"profiles\")\n    .select(\"is_verified, role\")\n    .eq(\"id\", user.id)\n    .single();\n\n  if (!profile?.is_verified) {\n    redirect(\"/verify\");\n  }\n\n  if (profile.role !== \"coach\" &amp;&amp; profile.role !== \"admin\") {\n    redirect(\"/dashboard/reservations\");\n  }\n\n  const isAdmin = profile.role === \"admin\";\n\n  // Fetch all data\n  const [roomsResult, schedulesResult, breaksResult, teamsResult, issuesResult] = await Promise.all([\n    // Rooms that can have TS\n    supabase\n      .from(\"rooms\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .eq(\"can_have_ts\", true)\n      .order(\"code\"),\n\n    // Recurring schedules with team info\n    supabase\n      .from(\"recurring_schedules\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name),\n        team:teams(id, name)\n      &#96;)\n      .gte(\"valid_until\", new Date().toISOString().split(\"T\")[0])\n      .order(\"day_of_week\"),\n\n    // Schedule breaks\n    supabase\n      .from(\"schedule_breaks\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .gte(\"end_date\", new Date().toISOString().split(\"T\")[0])\n      .order(\"start_date\"),\n\n    // Teams for TS assignment\n    supabase\n      .from(\"teams\")\n      .select(\"id, name, year\")\n      .eq(\"is_active\", true)\n      .order(\"year\")\n      .order(\"name\"),\n\n    // Room issues\n    supabase\n      .from(\"room_issues\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name),\n        reporter:profiles!reported_by(id, full_name),\n        resolver:profiles!resolved_by(id, full_name)\n      &#96;)\n      .order(\"created_at\", { ascending: false })\n      .limit(50),\n  ]);\n\n  const rooms = (roomsResult.data || []) as Room[];\n  const schedules = (schedulesResult.data || []) as (RecurringSchedule &amp; { room: Room; team: { id: string; name: string } })[];\n  const breaks = (breaksResult.data || []) as ScheduleBreak[];\n}",

token !== cronSecret) {\n        return NextResponse.json({ error: \"Neplatný token\" }, { status: 401 });\n      }\n    } else {\n      // If called by user, just verify they are authenticated\n      // HC generation is a system task that benefits everyone\n      const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n      if (!user) {\n        return NextResponse.json({ error: \"Neautorizováno\" }, { status: 401 });\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Get D107 room using admin client (bypasses RLS)\n    const { data: room } = await adminClient\n      .from(\"rooms\")\n      .select(\"id\")\n      .eq(\"code\", \"d107\")\n      .single();\n\n    if (!room) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: \"Místnost D107 nenalezena\" }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    // Get schedule breaks for a wide range (past and future) using admin client\n    const now = new Date();\n    const sixMonthsAgo = addMonths(now, -6);\n    const sixMonthsLater = addMonths(now, 6);\n    const { data: scheduleBreaks } = await adminClient\n      .from(\"schedule_breaks\")\n      .select(\"start_date, end_date\")\n      .lte(\"start_date\", sixMonthsLater.toISOString().split(\"T\")[0])\n      .gte(\"end_date\", sixMonthsAgo.toISOString().split(\"T\")[0]);\n\n    const breaks = scheduleBreaks || [];\n\n    // Generate HC for past 3 months, current month, and next 6 months\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Checks if the authenticated user has a linked profile\n * @param supabaseClient - Supabase client to use. Must be provided to use existing client.\n * @returns true if user has a linked profile, false otherwise\n */\nexport async function hasLinkedProfile(\n  supabaseClient: SupabaseClient\n): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n  const { data: { user }, error: authError } = await supabaseClient.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (authError || !user) {\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Query profiles directly - RLS policy ensures user can only see their own profile\n  // The RLS policy checks: user_id in (select id from public.users where auth_user_id = auth.uid())\n  // This is more reliable than nested selects with RLS\n  const { data: profiles, error: queryError } = await supabaseClient\n    .from(\"profiles\")\n    .select(\"id\")\n    .limit(1);\n\n  // Return false if query failed or no profiles found\n  if (queryError || !profiles) {\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Check if at least one profile exists\n  return Array.isArray(profiles) &amp;&amp; profiles.length &gt; 0;\n}\n\n/**\n * Creates an error URL with the given error message\n */\nexport function createErrorUrl(request: NextRequest, errorMessage: string): URL {\n  const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n}",

        "contents": "-- Users can update their own user record\ncreate policy \"Users can update their own user record\" on public.users\nfor update\nto authenticated\nusing ( (select auth.uid()) = auth_user_id )\nwith check ( (select auth.uid()) = auth_user_id );\n\n-- Users can insert their own user record (during signup via trigger)\ncreate policy \"Users can insert their own user record\" on public.users\nfor insert\nto authenticated\nwith check ( (select auth.uid()) = auth_user_id );\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- RLS POLICIES - PROFILES TABLE\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Users can view their own profile\ncreate policy \"Users can view their own profile\" on public.profiles\nfor select\nto authenticated\nusing (\n  user_id in (\n    select id\n    from public.users\n    where auth_user_id = (select auth.uid())\n  )\n);\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- RLS POLICIES - REALTIME MESSAGES TABLE\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Users can receive broadcasts for their own user record\ncreate policy \"Users can receive broadcasts for their own user record\" on realtime.messages\nfor select\nto authenticated\nusing (\n  topic like 'users:%'\n  and exists (\n    select 1\n    from public.users\n    where auth_user_id = (select auth.uid())\n    and topic = 'users:' || id::text\n  )\n);\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- GRANTS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Grant execute permissions for Supabase Auth hook function\n-- Trigger functions (handle_new_auth_user, validate_czu_email_domain_trigger) are invoked by triggers, not directly, so no EXECUTE grants needed\ngrant execute on function public.before_user_created_hook(jsonb) to supabase_auth_admin;\ngrant usage on schema public to supabase_auth_admin;\nrevoke execute on function public.before_user_created_hook(jsonb) from anon, authenticated, public;",

        "contents": "- &#96;anon&#96;: an unauthenticated request (the user is not logged in)\n- &#96;authenticated&#96;: an authenticated request (the user is logged in)\n\nThese are actually [Postgres Roles](mdc:docs/guides/database/postgres/roles). You can use these roles within your Policies using the &#96;TO&#96; clause:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Profiles are viewable by everyone\"\non profiles\nfor select\nto authenticated, anon\nusing ( true );\n\n-- OR\n\ncreate policy \"Public profiles are viewable only by authenticated users\"\non profiles\nfor select\nto authenticated\nusing ( true );\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nNote that &#96;for ...&#96; must be added after the table but before the roles. &#96;to ...&#96; must be added after &#96;for ...&#96;:\n\n### Incorrect\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Public profiles are viewable only by authenticated users\"\non profiles\nto authenticated\nfor select\nusing ( true );\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Correct\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Public profiles are viewable only by authenticated users\"\non profiles\nfor select\nto authenticated\nusing ( true );\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Multiple operations\n\nPostgreSQL policies do not support specifying multiple operations in a single FOR clause. You need to create separate policies for each operation.\n\n### Incorrect\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Profiles can be created and deleted by any user\"\non profiles\nfor insert, delete -- cannot create a policy on multiple operators\nto authenticated\nwith check ( true )\nusing ( true );\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Correct\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Profiles can be created by any user\"\non profiles\nfor insert\nto authenticated\nwith check ( true );\n\ncreate policy \"Profiles can be deleted by any user\"\non profiles\nfor delete\nto authenticated\nusing ( true );\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Helper functions\n\nSupabase provides some helper functions that make it easier to write Policies.\n\n### &#96;auth.uid()&#96;\n\nReturns the ID of the user making the request.\n\n### &#96;auth.jwt()&#96;\n\nReturns the JWT of the user making the request. Anything that you store in the user's &#96;raw_app_meta_data&#96; column or the &#96;raw_user_meta_data&#96; column will be accessible using this function. It's important to know the distinction between these two:\n\n- &#96;raw_user_meta_data&#96; - can be updated by the authenticated user using the &#96;supabase.auth.update()&#96; function. It is not a good place to store authorization data.",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport {\n  Card,\n  CardContent,\n  CardDescription,\n  CardHeader,\n  CardTitle,\n} from \"@/components/ui/card\";\nimport { Badge } from \"@/components/ui/badge\";\nimport { User, Users, Shield } from \"lucide-react\";\n\nconst ROLE_LABELS: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {\n  student: \"Student\",\n  team_leader: \"Team Leader\",\n  coach: \"Kouč\",\n  admin: \"Admin\",\n};\n\nexport default async function DashboardPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const {\n    data: { user },\n  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (!user) {\n    redirect(\"/\");\n  }\n\n  // Get profile with team info\n  const { data: profile } = await supabase\n    .from(\"profiles\")\n    .select(\n      &#96;\n      *,\n      teams (\n        id,\n        name,\n        year\n      )\n    &#96;\n    )\n    .eq(\"id\", user.id)\n    .single();\n\n  // Redirect unverified users to verify page\n  if (!profile?.is_verified) {\n    redirect(\"/verify\");\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"mb-8\"&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Users can access their own records\" on test_table\nto authenticated\nusing ( (select auth.uid()) = user_id );\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nYou can add an index like:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate index userid\non test_table\nusing btree (user_id);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Call functions with &#96;select&#96;\n\nYou can use &#96;select&#96; statement to improve policies that use functions. For example, instead of this:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Users can access their own records\" on test_table\nto authenticated\nusing ( auth.uid() = user_id );\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nYou can do:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Users can access their own records\" on test_table\nto authenticated\nusing ( (select auth.uid()) = user_id );\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThis method works well for JWT functions like &#96;auth.uid()&#96; and &#96;auth.jwt()&#96; as well as &#96;security definer&#96; Functions. Wrapping the function causes an &#96;initPlan&#96; to be run by the Postgres optimizer, which allows it to \"cache\" the results per-statement, rather than calling the function on each row.\n\nCaution: You can only use this technique if the results of the query or function do not change based on the row data.\n\n### Minimize joins\n\nYou can often rewrite your Policies to avoid joins between the source and the target table. Instead, try to organize your policy to fetch all the relevant data from the target table into an array or set, then you can use an &#96;IN&#96; or &#96;ANY&#96; operation in your filter.\n\nFor example, this is an example of a slow policy which joins the source &#96;test_table&#96; to the target &#96;team_user&#96;:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Users can access records belonging to their teams\" on test_table\nto authenticated\nusing (\n  (select auth.uid()) in (\n    select user_id\n    from team_user\n    where team_user.team_id = team_id -- joins to the source \"test_table.team_id\"\n  )\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nWe can rewrite this to avoid this join, and instead select the filter criteria into a set:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Users can access records belonging to their teams\" on test_table\nto authenticated\nusing (\n  team_id in (\n    select team_id\n    from team_user",

        "contents": "---\ndescription: Guidelines for writing Postgres Row Level Security policies\nalwaysApply: false\n---\n\n# Database: Create RLS policies\n\nYou're a Supabase Postgres expert in writing row level security policies. Your purpose is to generate a policy with the constraints given by the user. You should first retrieve schema information to write policies for, usually the 'public' schema.\n\nThe output should use the following instructions:\n\n- The generated SQL must be valid SQL.\n- You can use only CREATE POLICY or ALTER POLICY queries, no other queries are allowed.\n- Always use double apostrophe in SQL strings (eg. 'Night''s watch')\n- You can add short explanations to your messages.\n- The result should be a valid markdown. The SQL code should be wrapped in &#96;&#96;&#96; (including sql language tag).\n- Always use \"auth.uid()\" instead of \"current_user\".\n- SELECT policies should always have USING but not WITH CHECK\n- INSERT policies should always have WITH CHECK but not USING\n- UPDATE policies should always have WITH CHECK and most often have USING\n- DELETE policies should always have USING but not WITH CHECK\n- Don't use &#96;FOR ALL&#96;. Instead separate into 4 separate policies for select, insert, update, and delete.\n- The policy name should be short but detailed text explaining the policy, enclosed in double quotes.\n- Always put explanations as separate text. Never use inline SQL comments.\n- If the user asks for something that's not related to SQL policies, explain to the user\n  that you can only help with policies.\n- Discourage &#96;RESTRICTIVE&#96; policies and encourage &#96;PERMISSIVE&#96; policies, and explain why.\n\nThe output should look like this:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE POLICY \"My descriptive policy.\" ON books FOR INSERT to authenticated USING ( (select auth.uid()) = author_id ) WITH ( true );\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nSince you are running in a Supabase environment, take note of these Supabase-specific additions below.\n\n## Authenticated and unauthenticated roles\n\nSupabase maps every request to one of the roles:\n\n- &#96;anon&#96;: an unauthenticated request (the user is not logged in)\n- &#96;authenticated&#96;: an authenticated request (the user is logged in)",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "---",

            "text": "---",

            "text": "# Database: Create RLS policies",

            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "The output should use the following instructions:",
            "lineNumber": 10

          {
            "text": "- You can add short explanations to your messages.",

          },
          {
            "text": "- The result should be a valid markdown. The SQL code should be wrapped in &#96;&#96;&#96; (including sql language tag).",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "- Always use \"auth.uid()\" instead of \"current_user\".",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "- SELECT policies should always have USING but not WITH CHECK",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "- INSERT policies should always have WITH CHECK but not USING",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "- UPDATE policies should always have WITH CHECK and most often have USING",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "- DELETE policies should always have USING but not WITH CHECK",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "- Don't use &#96;FOR ALL&#96;. Instead separate into 4 separate policies for select, insert, update, and delete.",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- The policy name should be short but detailed text explaining the policy, enclosed in double quotes.",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- Always put explanations as separate text. Never use inline SQL comments.",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "- If the user asks for something that's not related to SQL policies, explain to the user",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "  that you can only help with policies.",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- Discourage &#96;RESTRICTIVE&#96; policies and encourage &#96;PERMISSIVE&#96; policies, and explain why.",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "The output should look like this:",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "CREATE POLICY \"My descriptive policy.\" ON books FOR INSERT to authenticated USING ( (select auth.uid()) = author_id ) WITH ( true );",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "Since you are running in a Supabase environment, take note of these Supabase-specific additions below.",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36

        "contents": "/**\n * Main reservations page showing all rooms and user's reservations\n */\nexport default async function ReservationsPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  \n  // Get current user\n  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n  if (!user) {\n    redirect(\"/\");\n  }\n\n  // Check if verified\n  const { data: profile } = await supabase\n    .from(\"profiles\")\n    .select(\"is_verified\")\n    .eq(\"id\", user.id)\n    .single();\n\n  if (!profile?.is_verified) {\n    redirect(\"/verify\");\n  }\n\n  // Fetch rooms with current reservations and issues\n  const now = new Date().toISOString();\n  \n  const [roomsResult, reservationsResult, issuesResult, myReservationsResult, joinedIdsResult, coworksResult] = await Promise.all([\n    // All rooms\n    supabase\n      .from(\"rooms\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .order(\"code\"),\n    \n    // Current and upcoming reservations for today\n    supabase\n      .from(\"reservations\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n      .gte(\"end_time\", now)\n      .lte(\"start_time\", new Date(Date.now() + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString())\n      .order(\"start_time\"),\n    \n    // Open issues\n    supabase\n      .from(\"room_issues\")\n      .select(\"room_id, issue_type\")\n      .eq(\"status\", \"open\"),\n    \n    // User's own reservations\n    supabase\n      .from(\"reservations\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name)\n      &#96;)\n      .eq(\"user_id\", user.id)\n      .eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n      .gte(\"end_time\", now)\n      .order(\"start_time\")\n      .limit(10),\n    \n    // Get reservation IDs user has joined\n    supabase\n      .from(\"cowork_participants\")\n      .select(\"reservation_id\")\n      .eq(\"user_id\", user.id),\n    \n    // Available coworks (open for cowork, active, upcoming - include all, we'll filter later)\n;\n}",

        "contents": "-- References the new users table instead of auth.users\ncreate table public.profiles (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  name text not null,\n  picture text,\n  user_id uuid unique references public.users(id) on delete set null,\n  work_email text unique not null,\n  role public.profile_role not null default 'student',\n  team_id uuid references public.teams(id) on delete set null,\n  phone_number text,\n  personal_email text,\n  date_of_birth date,\n  removed_access timestamptz,\n  removed_access_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  constraint valid_czu_domain check (\n    work_email like '%@studenti.czu.cz' or work_email like '%@pef.czu.cz'\n  )\n);\n\ncomment on table public.profiles is 'User profile data with role and team membership. Pre-created by admin, linked to user after OTP verification.';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- FUNCTIONS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger function to automatically update updated_at column\ncreate or replace function public.handle_updated_at()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity invoker\nset search_path = ''\nas $$\nbegin\n  new.updated_at := now();\n  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\ncomment on function public.handle_updated_at() is 'Trigger function that automatically updates the updated_at column to the current timestamp on row updates.';\n\n-- Create trigger function to populate public.users on auth.users creation\n-- Extracts Google OAuth data from auth.users.raw_user_meta_data and auth.users.email\ncreate or replace function public.handle_new_auth_user()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nset search_path = public, auth\nas $$\ndeclare\n  v_google_email text;\n  v_google_full_name text;\n  v_google_profile_picture text;\n  v_raw_meta_data jsonb;\nbegin\n  v_raw_meta_data := new.raw_user_meta_data;",

        "contents": "-- Migration: Link users to profiles based on email matching\n-- Purpose: Automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email\n-- Affected tables: profiles, users, auth.users\n-- Special considerations: Runs automatically when user email changes in auth.users table\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- FUNCTIONS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger function to link profiles to users based on email matching\n-- Matches auth.users.email with profiles.work_email and links via public.users\n-- Runs with SECURITY DEFINER to access auth.users table\ncreate or replace function public.link_user_to_profile()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nset search_path = public, auth\nas $$\ndeclare\n  v_user_id uuid;\n  v_auth_email text;\nbegin\n  -- Get the email from auth.users (use NEW.email after update)\n  v_auth_email := new.email;\n  \n  -- Only proceed if email is not null and has changed\n  if v_auth_email is null or v_auth_email = '' then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Find the public.users row that matches this auth.users.id\n  select id into v_user_id\n  from public.users\n  where auth_user_id = new.id;\n  \n  -- If no matching public.users row found, return early\n  if v_user_id is null then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Link profile to user if work_email matches auth.users.email\n  -- Only update if profile exists and is not already linked to a different user\n  -- Normalize both sides of comparison to handle case/whitespace differences\n  update public.profiles\n  set user_id = v_user_id\n  where lower(trim(work_email)) = lower(trim(v_auth_email))\n    and (user_id is null or user_id = v_user_id);\n  \n  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\ncomment on function public.link_user_to_profile() is 'Trigger function that automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email. Matches based on currently logged in user email (auth.users.email), uid in user table row (public.users.auth_user_id), and work_email in profile table row (public.profiles.work_email).';\n\n-- ============================================================================",

        "contents": "-- Migration: Initial schema setup\n-- Purpose: Creates complete database schema with tables, triggers, and restrictive RLS policies\n-- Affected tables: users, profiles, teams\n-- Special considerations: All RLS policies are restrictive - admin operations require service_role or application-level checks\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- ENUM TYPES\n-- ============================================================================\n\ncreate type public.profile_role as enum ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- TABLES\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create users table (custom table, separate from auth.users)\n-- Stores Google OAuth user data and OTP tracking\n-- Linked to auth.users via auth_user_id for authentication checks\ncreate table public.users (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  auth_user_id uuid unique references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,\n  google_email text not null unique,\n  suggested_work_email text,\n  verified_work_email text,\n  verified_work_email_at timestamptz,\n  google_profile_picture text,\n  google_full_name text,\n  last_otp_sent_at timestamptz,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null\n);\n\ncomment on table public.users is 'Custom users table storing Google OAuth user data and OTP tracking.         "contents": "CREATE INDEX idx_profiles_is_verified ON profiles(is_verified);\nCREATE INDEX idx_pre_registered_emails_email ON pre_registered_emails(email);\nCREATE INDEX idx_pre_registered_emails_claimed_by ON pre_registered_emails(claimed_by);\nCREATE INDEX idx_verification_codes_user_id ON verification_codes(user_id);\nCREATE INDEX idx_verification_codes_school_email ON verification_codes(school_email);\nCREATE INDEX idx_verification_codes_expires_at ON verification_codes(expires_at);\n\n-- Function to handle new user signup\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()\nRETURNS TRIGGER AS $$\nBEGIN\n    INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, full_name, role, team_id, is_verified, locale, created_at, updated_at)\n    VALUES (\n        NEW.id,\n        COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'full_name', ''),\n        COALESCE((NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'role')::user_role, 'student'),\n        CASE \n            WHEN NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'team_id' IS NOT NULL \n            THEN (NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'team_id')::UUID \n            ELSE NULL \n        END,\n        FALSE,\n        COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'locale', 'cs'),\n        NOW(),\n        NOW()\n    );\n    RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;\n\n-- Trigger to create profile on user signup\nCREATE TRIGGER on_auth_user_created\n    AFTER INSERT ON auth.users\n    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user();\n\n-- Function to update updated_at timestamp\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at_column()\nRETURNS TRIGGER AS $$\nBEGIN\n    NEW.updated_at = NOW();\n    RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;\n\n-- Trigger to auto-update updated_at on profiles\nCREATE TRIGGER update_profiles_updated_at\n    BEFORE UPDATE ON profiles\n    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at_column();\n\n-- Row Level Security (RLS) Policies\n\n-- Enable RLS on all tables\nALTER TABLE teams ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;\nALTER TABLE profiles ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;\nALTER TABLE pre_registered_emails ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;\nALTER TABLE         "contents": "comment on function public.link_user_to_profile() is 'Trigger function that automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email. Matches based on currently logged in user email (auth.users.email), uid in user table row (public.users.auth_user_id), and work_email in profile table row (public.profiles.work_email).';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- TRIGGERS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger on auth.users table to link profiles when email changes\n-- Runs AFTER UPDATE to ensure email change is committed\ndrop trigger if exists link_user_to_profile_trigger on auth.users;\n\ncreate trigger link_user_to_profile_trigger\nafter update of email on auth.users\nfor each row\nwhen (old.email is distinct from new.email)\nexecute function public.link_user_to_profile();\n\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- INITIAL DATA LINKING\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Link existing profiles to users based on current email matches\n-- This handles any existing data that needs to be linked\n-- Normalize both sides of comparison to handle case/whitespace differences\nupdate public.profiles p\nset user_id = u.id\nfrom public.users u\ninner join auth.users au on u.auth_user_id = au.id\nwhere lower(trim(p.work_email)) = lower(trim(au.email))\n  and (p.user_id is null or p.user_id = u.id);\n\ncomment on table public.profiles is 'User profile data with role and team membership. Pre-created by admin, linked to user after OTP verification. Automatically linked when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email.';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- GRANTS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Grant execute permissions for the trigger function\ngrant execute on function public.link_user_to_profile() to authenticated;",

        },
        "contents": "await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,\n    picture: user.user_metadata.avatar_url  // Default to Google picture\n  })\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 4: Middleware Validation\n\nQuery database for profile linked to current auth.user and check &#96;removed_access IS NULL&#96; on every request to protected routes.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Middleware check\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id, role, removed_access')\n  .eq('user_id', user.id)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) redirect('/auth/verify-work-email');\nif (profile.removed_access) redirect('/auth/access-revoked');\n// User has active access, continue...\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Estimated Complexity\n\n| Task | Complexity | Lines of Code |\n\n|------|------------|---------------|\n\n| Delete old auth files | Trivial | -500 lines |\n\n| Security lockdown config | Trivial | ~20 lines TOML |\n\n| Database migration | Low | ~40 lines SQL (users, profiles, indexes) |\n\n| Constants + validation | Trivial | ~25 lines |\n\n| Server actions (auth logic) | Medium | ~60 lines |\n\n| Middleware update | Medium | ~50 lines (includes DB queries) |\n\n| Google login page | Low | ~30 lines |\n\n| Work email form + linking | Medium | ~120 lines |\n\n| Pending approval page | Low | ~20 lines |\n\n| Access revoked page | Low | ~20 lines |\n\n**Total new code**: ~385 lines (vs ~500 lines deleted)\n\n## Separation of Concerns\n\n### Supabase (Auth + Storage Only)\n\n- **Authentication**: Google OAuth flow, session management, OTP emails\n- **Database**: Store profiles and users data (no RLS - Next.js handles access control)\n- **No business logic**: No custom hooks, no stored procedures, no triggers, no functions\n\n### Next.js (All Business Logic)\n\n- **Middleware**: Profile verification, access checks, role-based routing\n- **Server Actions**: Profile linking, access revocation\n- **Validation**: Domain validation, input sanitization, business rules\n- **Authorization**: Role hierarchy checks, permission enforcement\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                         Next.js                                  │",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "await supabase",
            "lineNumber": 323
          },

            "text": "  .from('profiles')",

          },

          {
            "text": "### Step 4: Middleware Validation",
            "lineNumber": 332
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 333
          },
          {
            "text": "Query database for profile linked to current auth.user and check &#96;removed_access IS NULL&#96; on every request to protected routes.",
            "lineNumber": 334
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 335
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
            "lineNumber": 336
          },
          {
            "text": "// Middleware check",
            "lineNumber": 337
          },
          {
            "text": "const { data: profile } = await supabase",
            "lineNumber": 338
          },
          {
            "text": "  .from('profiles')",
            "lineNumber": 339
          },
          {
            "text": "  .select('id, role, removed_access')",
            "lineNumber": 340
          },
          {
            "text": "  .eq('user_id', user.id)",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 343
          },
          {

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "## Separation of Concerns",
            "lineNumber": 377
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 378
          },
          {
            "text": "### Supabase (Auth + Storage Only)",
            "lineNumber": 379
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 380
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Authentication**: Google OAuth flow, session management, OTP emails",
            "lineNumber": 381
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Database**: Store profiles and users data (no RLS - Next.js handles access control)",
            "lineNumber": 382
          },
          {
            "text": "- **No business logic**: No custom hooks, no stored procedures, no triggers, no functions",
            "lineNumber": 383
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 384
          },
          {
            "text": "### Next.js (All Business Logic)",

          },

          },

          },

          },

        "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  // Allow public routes without authentication\n  if (isPublicRoute(pathname)) {\n    // Handle authenticated users visiting login page - redirect them\n    if (pathname === \"/auth/login\") {\n      // Use getUser() instead of getClaims() to validate the user actually exists\n      // getClaims() can return truthy values even with invalid/deleted users\n      const { data: { user }, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n      // Only redirect if we have a valid user (not just claims)\n      // This prevents infinite redirect loops when token is invalid but claims exist\n      if (!error &amp;&amp; user) {\n        // Get next parameter from query string\n        const next = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get(\"next\");\n\n        // Validate next parameter to prevent open redirects\n        const origin = request.nextUrl.origin;\n        const validatedNext = next ? validateRedirectUrl(next, origin) : null;\n        const redirectTo = validatedNext ?? DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE;\n\n        const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n        url.pathname = redirectTo;\n        url.search = \"\"; // Clear existing search params\n        url.hash = \"\"; // Clear existing hash\n        return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n      }\n    }\n    return supabaseResponse;\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!user) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    url.search = \"\"; // Clear existing search params\n    url.hash = \"\"; // Clear existing hash\n    url.searchParams.set(\"next\", fullPath);\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth providers like Google)\n  const { data: getUserData, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n  const authUser = getUserData?.user;\n\n  if (error) {\n    console.error(\"supabase.auth.getUser error\", error);\n  }\n\n  if (!authUser) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n}",

        "contents": "-- Create trigger on auth.users table for email domain validation\ndrop trigger if exists validate_czu_email_domain_trigger on auth.users;\n\ncreate trigger validate_czu_email_domain_trigger\nbefore update of email, email_change on auth.users\nfor each row\nexecute function public.validate_czu_email_domain_trigger();\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- INDEXES\n-- ============================================================================\n\ncreate index profiles_user_id_idx on public.profiles(user_id);\ncreate index profiles_work_email_idx on public.profiles(work_email);\ncreate index profiles_team_id_idx on public.profiles(team_id);\ncreate index profiles_team_id_user_id_idx on public.profiles(team_id, user_id);\ncreate index users_google_email_idx on public.users(google_email);\ncreate index users_suggested_work_email_idx on public.users(suggested_work_email);\ncreate index if not exists idx_realtime_messages_topic on realtime.messages(topic);\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- REALTIME\n-- ============================================================================\n\nalter publication supabase_realtime add table public.users;\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- ROW LEVEL SECURITY\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Enable RLS on all tables\nalter table public.users enable row level security;\nalter table public.profiles enable row level security;\nalter table public.teams enable row level security;\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- RLS POLICIES -       "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.cursor/plans/work_email_auth_system_467a2b18.plan.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 193
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 254
          }
        },
        "contents": "## Supabase Configuration Changes\n\nUpdate [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\n\n[auth.email]\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true\nclient_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"\nsecret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\n\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\n\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &#96;profiles.user_id&#96; matches current auth.user.id\n- **Access Active**: Check &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;\n- **User Role**: Read &#96;profiles.role&#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\n\nThis approach:\n\n- Keeps all business logic in Next.js (single source of truth)\n- Allows real-time updates (e.g., instant access revocation)\n- Admin pre-creates profiles, users link via work email verification\n- Supabase only handles auth + data storage (no custom hooks or functions)\n\n## Development &amp; Testing with Supabase MCP\n\nThe project has a &#96;supabase/&#96; directory with Supabase MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration available for:\n\n1. **Running migrations**: Apply and test database schema changes locally\n2. **Debugging auth flow**: Inspect user sessions and profile data\n3. **Testing verification logic**: Query profiles table for auth checks\n\n**Useful MCP commands for development:**\n\n- Seed test data into profiles table for auth testing\n- Inspect auth.users and profiles tables\n- Test profile linking and access revocation queries\n\n## Key Security Features\n\n### Supabase (Data Layer Only)\n\n1. **Database Constraints**:\n\n   - Domain constraint ensures only valid CZU domains in profiles\n   - Unique constraints on work_email, user_id\n\n2. **No RLS or Functions**:\n\n   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions",

        "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  if (!authUser) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    url.search = \"\"; // Clear existing search params\n    url.hash = \"\"; // Clear existing hash\n    url.searchParams.set(\"next\", fullPath);\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // If no email identity, redirect to verify email page\n  // Treat errors as \"no identity\" to preserve graceful redirect behavior\n  const emailIdentityCheck = await safeCheck(\n    () =&gt; hasEmailIdentity(supabase),\n    \"hasEmailIdentity\",\n  );\n  if (!emailIdentityCheck.ok) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/verify-email\";\n    url.search = \"\"; // Clear existing search params\n    url.hash = \"\"; // Clear existing hash\n    url.searchParams.set(\"next\", fullPath);\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // Check for linked profile if user is authenticated and not on public routes\n  // Skip this check for verify-email and pending-approval routes\n  // Treat errors as \"no profile\" to preserve graceful redirect behavior\n  const linkedProfileCheck = await safeCheck(\n    () =&gt; hasLinkedProfile(supabase),\n    \"hasLinkedProfile\",\n  );\n  if (!linkedProfileCheck.ok) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/pending-approval\";\n    url.search = \"\"; // Strip all query parameters (e.g., from email verification or QR code)\n    url.hash = \"\"; // Strip hash as well\n    url.searchParams.set(\"next\", fullPath);\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // For protected routes (dashboard, etc.), we need to check verification\n  // This is done on the page level for better UX with proper error messages\n\n  return supabaseResponse;\n}",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport Link from \"next/link\";\nimport { hasEmailIdentity, hasLinkedProfile } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport { LogoutButton } from \"@/components/logout-button\";\n\n/**\n * Pending approval page\n * Shown to users who have verified their email but don't have a linked profile yet\n */\nexport default async function PendingApprovalPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to verify email if no email identity linked\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity(supabase);\n  if (!hasEmail) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/verify-email\");\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to protected if already has linked profile\n  const hasProfile = await hasLinkedProfile(supabase);\n  if (hasProfile) {\n    redirect(DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE);\n  }\n\n  // Get user's email address\n  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n  const userEmail = user?.email || \"your email\";\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10 relative\n}",

        "contents": "ALTER TABLE verification_codes ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;\n\n-- Teams: Anyone authenticated can read active teams\nCREATE POLICY \"Anyone can view active teams\" ON teams\n    FOR SELECT USING (is_active = true);\n\n-- Teams: Only admins can modify teams\nCREATE POLICY \"Admins can manage teams\" ON teams\n    FOR ALL USING (\n        EXISTS (\n            SELECT 1 FROM profiles \n            WHERE profiles.id = auth.uid() \n            AND profiles.role = 'admin'\n        )\n    );\n\n-- Profiles: Users can read their own profile\nCREATE POLICY \"Users can view own profile\" ON profiles\n    FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = id);\n\n-- Profiles: Verified users can view other profiles in their team\nCREATE POLICY \"Verified users can view team profiles\" ON profiles\n    FOR SELECT USING (\n        EXISTS (\n            SELECT 1 FROM profiles AS viewer\n            WHERE viewer.id = auth.uid()\n            AND viewer.is_verified = true\n            AND (\n                viewer.team_id = profiles.team_id\n                OR viewer.role IN ('coach', 'admin')\n            )\n        )\n    );\n\n-- Profiles: Users can update their own profile\nCREATE POLICY \"Users can update own profile\" ON profiles\n    FOR UPDATE USING (auth.uid() = id)\n    WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = id);\n\n-- Profiles: Admins can manage all profiles\nCREATE POLICY \"Admins can manage all profiles\" ON profiles\n    FOR ALL USING (\n        EXISTS (\n            SELECT 1 FROM profiles \n            WHERE profiles.id = auth.uid() \n            AND profiles.role = 'admin'\n        )\n    );\n\n-- Pre-registered emails: Users can check if their email exists\nCREATE POLICY \"Users can check pre-registered emails\" ON pre_registered_emails\n    FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() IS NOT NULL);\n\n-- Pre-registered emails: Only admins can modify\nCREATE POLICY \"Admins can manage pre-registered emails\" ON pre_registered_emails\n    FOR ALL USING (\n        EXISTS (\n            SELECT 1 FROM profiles ",

        "contents": "/**\n * Checks if the authenticated user has a linked profile\n * @param supabaseClient - Supabase client to use. Must be provided to use existing client.\n * @returns true if user has a linked profile, false otherwise\n */\nexport async function hasLinkedProfile(\n  supabaseClient: SupabaseClient\n): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n  const { data: { user }, error: authError } = await supabaseClient.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (authError || !user) {\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Query profiles directly - RLS policy ensures user can only see their own profile\n  // The RLS policy checks: user_id in (select id from public.users where auth_user_id = auth.uid())\n  // This is more reliable than nested selects with RLS\n  const { data: profiles, error: queryError } = await supabaseClient\n    .from(\"profiles\")\n    .select(\"id\")\n    .limit(1);\n\n  // Return false if query failed or no profiles found\n  if (queryError || !profiles) {\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Check if at least one profile exists\n  return Array.isArray(profiles) &amp;&amp; profiles.length &gt; 0;\n}\n\n/**\n * Creates an error URL with the given error message\n */\nexport function createErrorUrl(request: NextRequest, errorMessage: string): URL {\n  const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n}",

        "contents": "- &#96;anon&#96;: an unauthenticated request (the user is not logged in)\n- &#96;authenticated&#96;: an authenticated request (the user is logged in)\n\nThese are actually [Postgres Roles](mdc:docs/guides/database/postgres/roles). You can use these roles within your Policies using the &#96;TO&#96; clause:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Profiles are viewable by everyone\"\non profiles\nfor select\nto authenticated, anon\nusing ( true );\n\n-- OR\n\ncreate policy \"Public profiles are viewable only by authenticated users\"\non profiles\nfor select\nto authenticated\nusing ( true );\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nNote that &#96;for ...&#96; must be added after the table but before the roles. &#96;to ...&#96; must be added after &#96;for ...&#96;:\n\n### Incorrect\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Public profiles are viewable only by authenticated users\"\non profiles\nto authenticated\nfor select\nusing ( true );\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Correct\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Public profiles are viewable only by authenticated users\"\non profiles\nfor select\nto authenticated\nusing ( true );\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Multiple operations\n\nPostgreSQL policies do not support specifying multiple operations in a single FOR clause. You need to create separate policies for each operation.\n\n### Incorrect\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Profiles can be created and deleted by any user\"\non profiles\nfor insert, delete -- cannot create a policy on multiple operators\nto authenticated\nwith check ( true )\nusing ( true );\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Correct\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Profiles can be created by any user\"\non profiles\nfor insert\nto authenticated\nwith check ( true );\n\ncreate policy \"Profiles can be deleted by any user\"\non profiles\nfor delete\nto authenticated\nusing ( true );\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Helper functions\n\nSupabase provides some helper functions that make it easier to write Policies.\n\n### &#96;auth.uid()&#96;\n\nReturns the ID of the user making the request.\n\n### &#96;auth.jwt()&#96;\n\nReturns the JWT of the user making the request. Anything that you store in the user's &#96;raw_app_meta_data&#96; column or the &#96;raw_user_meta_data&#96; column will be accessible using this function. It's important to know the distinction between these two:\n\n- &#96;raw_user_meta_data&#96; - can be updated by the authenticated user using the &#96;supabase.auth.update()&#96; function.         "contents": "to authenticated\nusing (\n  team_id in (\n    select team_id\n    from team_user\n    where user_id = (select auth.uid()) -- no join\n  )\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Specify roles in your policies\n\nAlways use the Role of inside your policies, specified by the &#96;TO&#96; operator. For example, instead of this query:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Users can access their own records\" on rls_test\nusing ( auth.uid() = user_id );\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nUse:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Users can access their own records\" on rls_test\nto authenticated\nusing ( (select auth.uid()) = user_id );\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThis prevents the policy &#96;( (select auth.uid()) = user_id )&#96; from running for any &#96;anon&#96; users, since the execution stops at the &#96;to authenticated&#96; step.",

        "contents": "/**\n * Main reservations page showing all rooms and user's reservations\n */\nexport default async function ReservationsPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  \n  // Get current user\n  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n  if (!user) {\n    redirect(\"/\");\n  }\n\n  // Check if verified\n  const { data: profile } = await supabase\n    .from(\"profiles\")\n    .select(\"is_verified\")\n    .eq(\"id\", user.id)\n    .single();\n\n  if (!profile?.is_verified) {\n    redirect(\"/verify\");\n  }\n\n  // Fetch rooms with current reservations and issues\n  const now = new Date().toISOString();\n  \n  const [roomsResult, reservationsResult, issuesResult, myReservationsResult, joinedIdsResult, coworksResult] = await Promise.all([\n    // All rooms\n    supabase\n      .from(\"rooms\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .order(\"code\"),\n    \n    // Current and upcoming reservations for today\n    supabase\n      .from(\"reservations\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n      .gte(\"end_time\", now)\n      .lte(\"start_time\", new Date(Date.now() + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString())\n      .order(\"start_time\"),\n    \n    // Open issues\n    supabase\n      .from(\"room_issues\")\n      .select(\"room_id, issue_type\")\n      .eq(\"status\", \"open\"),\n    \n    // User's own reservations\n    supabase\n      .from(\"reservations\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name)\n      &#96;)\n      .eq(\"user_id\", user.id)\n      .eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n      .gte(\"end_time\", now)\n      .order(\"start_time\")\n      .limit(10),\n    \n    // Get reservation IDs user has joined\n    supabase\n      .from(\"cowork_participants\")\n      .select(\"reservation_id\")\n      .eq(\"user_id\", user.id),\n    \n    // Available coworks (open for cowork, active, upcoming - include all, we'll filter later)\n;\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.cursor/rules/create-rls-policies.mdc",

        "contents": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Users can access their own records\" on test_table\nto authenticated\nusing ( (select auth.uid()) = user_id );\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nYou can add an index like:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate index userid\non test_table\nusing btree (user_id);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Call functions with &#96;select&#96;\n\nYou can use &#96;select&#96; statement to improve policies that use functions. For example, instead of this:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Users can access their own records\" on test_table\nto authenticated\nusing ( auth.uid() = user_id );\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nYou can do:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Users can access their own records\" on test_table\nto authenticated\nusing ( (select auth.uid()) = user_id );\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThis method works well for JWT functions like &#96;auth.uid()&#96; and &#96;auth.jwt()&#96; as well as &#96;security definer&#96; Functions. Wrapping the function causes an &#96;initPlan&#96; to be run by the Postgres optimizer, which allows it to \"cache\" the results per-statement, rather than calling the function on each row.\n\nCaution: You can only use this technique if the results of the query or function do not change based on the row data.\n\n### Minimize joins\n\nYou can often rewrite your Policies to avoid joins between the source and the target table. Instead, try to organize your policy to fetch all the relevant data from the target table into an array or set, then you can use an &#96;IN&#96; or &#96;ANY&#96; operation in your filter.\n\nFor example, this is an example of a slow policy which joins the source &#96;test_table&#96; to the target &#96;team_user&#96;:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Users can access records belonging to their teams\" on test_table\nto authenticated\nusing (\n  (select auth.uid()) in (\n    select user_id\n    from team_user\n    where team_user.team_id = team_id -- joins to the source \"test_table.team_id\"\n  )\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nWe can rewrite this to avoid this join, and instead select the filter criteria into a set:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Users can access records belonging to their teams\" on test_table\nto authenticated\nusing (\n  team_id in (\n    select team_id\n    from team_user",

        "contents": "-- Users can update their own user record\ncreate policy \"Users can update their own user record\" on public.users\nfor update\nto authenticated\nusing ( (select auth.uid()) = auth_user_id )\nwith check ( (select auth.uid()) = auth_user_id );\n\n-- Users can insert their own user record (during signup via trigger)\ncreate policy \"Users can insert their own user record\" on public.users\nfor insert\nto authenticated\nwith check ( (select auth.uid()) = auth_user_id );\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- RLS POLICIES -         "contents": "---\ndescription: Guidelines for writing Postgres Row Level Security policies\nalwaysApply: false\n---\n\n# Database: Create RLS policies\n\nYou're a Supabase Postgres expert in writing row level security policies. Your purpose is to generate a policy with the constraints given by the user. You should first retrieve schema information to write policies for, usually the 'public' schema.\n\nThe output should use the following instructions:\n\n- The generated SQL must be valid SQL.\n- You can use only CREATE POLICY or ALTER POLICY queries, no other queries are allowed.\n- Always use double apostrophe in SQL strings (eg. 'Night''s watch')\n- You can add short explanations to your messages.\n- The result should be a valid markdown. The SQL code should be wrapped in &#96;&#96;&#96; (including sql language tag).\n- Always use \"auth.uid()\" instead of \"current_user\".\n- SELECT policies should always have USING but not WITH CHECK\n- INSERT policies should always have WITH CHECK but not USING\n- UPDATE policies should always have WITH CHECK and most often have USING\n- DELETE policies should always have USING but not WITH CHECK\n- Don't use &#96;FOR ALL&#96;. Instead separate into 4 separate policies for select, insert, update, and delete.\n- The policy name should be short but detailed text explaining the policy, enclosed in double quotes.\n- Always put explanations as separate text. Never use inline SQL comments.\n- If the user asks for something that's not related to SQL policies, explain to the user\n  that you can only help with policies.\n- Discourage &#96;RESTRICTIVE&#96; policies and encourage &#96;PERMISSIVE&#96; policies, and explain why.\n\nThe output should look like this:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE POLICY \"My descriptive policy.\" ON books FOR INSERT to authenticated USING ( (select auth.uid()) = author_id ) WITH ( true );\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nSince you are running in a Supabase environment, take note of these Supabase-specific additions below.\n\n## Authenticated and unauthenticated roles\n\nSupabase maps every request to one of the roles:\n\n- &#96;anon&#96;: an unauthenticated request (the user is not logged in)\n- &#96;authenticated&#96;: an authenticated request (the user is logged in)",

          {
            "text": "- Always put explanations as separate text. Never use inline SQL comments.",
            "lineNumber": 24

          {
            "text": "- If the user asks for something that's not related to SQL policies, explain to the user",

          {
            "text": "  that you can only help with policies.",

          {

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport Link from \"next/link\";\nimport { hasEmailIdentity, hasLinkedProfile } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport { LogoutButton } from \"@/components/logout-button\";\n\n/**\n * Pending approval page\n * Shown to users who have verified their email but don't have a linked profile yet\n */\nexport default async function PendingApprovalPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to verify email if no email identity linked\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity(supabase);\n  if (!hasEmail) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/verify-email\");\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to protected if already has linked profile\n  const hasProfile = await hasLinkedProfile(supabase);\n  if (hasProfile) {\n    redirect(DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE);\n  }\n\n  // Get user's email address\n  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n  const userEmail = user?.email || \"your email\";\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10 relative\n}",
